entities.name: Musa'id bin Abdulaziz Al Saud
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Musa'id bin Abdulaziz Al Saud was the twelfth son of King Abdulaziz, the founder of Saudi Arabia. He was a businessman and the father of Faisal bin Musaid, the assassin of his half-brother King Faisal.
